name: Prestonwood Country Club – Creek
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2858, The Clubs of Prestonwood - The Creek); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 71). Combination tees left out. Men's ratings; Green's is for 5514 yards (the card's Green is 5590).
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: an OSM bunker on grass (trim_far.py drops the practice greens and short-game area).
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the bunkers on sand).
_comment_greenShift: OSM's greens sit about 3 m north-west of its bunkers: with the bunkers fitted to the sand, the greens move a further 1.8 m east and 2.5 m south (fit_shift.py green, checked by eye).
